# September market note — 37172

Six homes closed in the subdivision this summer. The middle of the adjusted
sales sits at $515,000, and sellers took about 4% under list on the trailing
ninety days. [source: MLS market stats, pulled 2026-08-29]

Two of those sales back the golf course, which is why online estimates run
high here. If you want the six sales side by side, ask. It takes ten minutes.
